name: Postman
description: Collections, environments and APIs in your Postman workspaces.
long_description: Postman's hosted server. It reads collections, requests and environments, and runs a request from a collection — which is how a chat exercises an API you already documented there.

auth.instructions: Sign in to Postman in your browser; the server registers Gantry on the spot.

risk.notes: Reaches your Postman workspaces. Running a saved request sends it to whatever API it points at, with whatever environment it carries.
